scope: Three log-Euler intervals; non-Gaussian second marginal, terminal variance-row Gamma and five terminal quote IV directions; earlier two rows fixed.

policy.scope: Three log-Euler intervals; non-Gaussian second marginal and terminal quote directions, earlier transitions fixed.

limitations: Only the third variance row is recovered. Initial and middle continuation Gamma remain unimplemented for three intervals.
Earlier two model transitions and quote maturities are frozen when bumping terminal IVs.
Full cross-quote covariance and full market-IV-chain acceptance are not provided by this API.
Numerical refinement is a convergence check, not a rigorous total quadrature-error bound.
Same-path direction SE is conditional on frozen pilot selection and excludes regularization bias.
